subject: CypherPoint: Control artifacts & delivery schedule
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@cypherpoint.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cypherpoint.com
Date: 2026-07-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: RFI: Controls evidence and timeline for SOC 2 / ISO 27001

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. CypherPoint's security team has kicked off the formal RFI for our vendor assessment. We need a control-level mapping that ties Redwood controls to the SIG v2021 / SOC 2 criteria and ISO 27001 Annex A where applicable. Specifically we need:

- A spreadsheet mapping control IDs to Redwood policies/processes and sample artifacts
- The most recent SOC 2 Type II report or an SOC letter if full report can't be shared yet
- ISO 27001 scope statement and certificate (if available)
- A short delivery schedule (dates) for the above and a plan for extra evidence (e.g., logs, config screenshots) for up to 10 prioritized controls

Can you confirm what you can deliver and by when? CypherPoint procurement would like the deliverables by COB 2026-07-12 if possible.

Best,
Tara
Tara Singh
Security Program Manager, CypherPoint
[Attachment: cypherpoint_rfi_instructions.pdf (PDF)]

---

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Tara Singh <tara@cypherpoint.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-08T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Controls evidence and timeline for SOC 2 / ISO 27001

Hi Tara — thanks for the clear ask and the target date. We can meet the request but need to scope the "up to 10 prioritized controls" you mentioned so we can prepare the right artifacts. High level delivery plan from Redwood: 

- 2026-07-09: Control mapping spreadsheet (initial draft) + index of available artifacts
- 2026-07-12: SOC 2 Type II redacted report (or attestation letter) + ISO 27001 scope statement
- 2026-07-14: Evidence pack for prioritized controls (logs, screenshots, config extracts) — staggered delivery if you prefer earlier items first

Internal owners: Marissa will coordinate artifacts and pack, Neha will handle SOC/ISO documentation, and Priyom will produce the detailed control mappings.

Action items:
- Tara: please send the top 10 controls you want prioritized (SIG control IDs or SOC criteria numbers) by EOD 2026-07-08 if you want the 7/12 deadline intact.
- CypherPoint procurement: confirm any NDA or redaction requirements before we send the SOC report.

I'll follow up with the initial mapping tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Product & Trust Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-09T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: CypherPoint artifact plan (DRAFT)

Markus / team — drafting what we'll include in each deliverable. Notes below; please flag if I'm missing anything.

Deliverable 1 (2026-07-09): Control mapping spreadsheet (CY-CP-2026-mapping.xlsx)
- Columns: ExternalControlID, RedwoodControlRef, ControlOwner, Description, EvidenceCandidates, EvidenceLocation, LastUpdated
- We'll pre-populate with SIG v2021 controls and SOC 2 common criteria mappings. Priyom will map the process controls; I'll add links to artifacts.

Deliverable 2 (2026-07-12): Documentation bundle
- redwood_soc2-report-2026-Q1.pdf (redacted) [Attachment stub]
- iso27001-scope-statement.pdf [Attachment stub]
- Policies: Access Control Policy (redwood_access_policy.pdf), Data Retention Policy (retention_policy.pdf)

Deliverable 3 (2026-07-14): Evidence pack (for up to 10 prioritized controls)
- evidence-pack-week1.zip (contains: auth-logs-samples.txt, infra-config-screenshots.zip, change-control-extracts.csv)

Open questions:
- If CypherPoint wants raw logs we need an approved sharing mechanism (S3 pre-signed or secure share) and acceptance of the evidence retention terms.
- Any preference on redaction level for SOC (full redaction vs key sections visible)?

I will start assembling the matrix today and link artifacts in Drive at https://drive.redwood.com/share/controls/CY-CP-2026.

-Marissa Cole
Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Tara Singh <tara@cypherpoint.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: CypherPoint Procurement <procurement@cypherpoint.com>, Elliot Roy <elliot.roy@cypherpoint.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Controls evidence and timeline for SOC 2 / ISO 27001

Thanks, Markus — that timeline looks workable. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We'll send the prioritized control list in the hour (SIG IDs).
- Procurement confirms: redaction OK for SOC report but we require an attestation letter if any system-to-system logs are omitted.
- For logs: secure S3 presigned URLs are acceptable, but we need proof of retention policy and access revocation procedure.

Also: can you include a short note mapping Redwood's "Dedicated" and "Private" deployment options to where customer data can and cannot be accessed by Redwood operations? That will help our InfoSec team sign off.

If you can get the initial spreadsheet by tomorrow morning (2026-07-11 09:00 PDT) that would keep us on track for the 7/12 milestone.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we will review the Drive link when you post.

Best,
Tara
Security Program Manager, CypherPoint

[Attachment referenced in thread: cypherpoint_prioritized_controls.xlsx]
